item.title: CapitaLand Ascendas Reit buys two Singapore industrial assets and Japan data centre for $1.4 bil
item.description: CapitaLand Ascendas Reit (CLAR) has announced the acquisition of three industrial assets across Singapore and Japan for $1.4 billion. Two of the assets are in Singapore. CLAR is buying a 100% stake in 25 Loyang Crescent, a cluster of ramp-up logistics and industrial buildings, for $504.2 million, including an upfront land premium of $46.35 million. item.description: Nicholas Wilson has been appointed as senior director for strategic research and advisory for capital markets, Asia Pacific (Apac), at Savills. According to the firm, Wilson will combine market research with transaction execution in this newly created role. item.title: A five-room flat along Boon Tiong Road was just sold for $1.649 million, marking a new record-high for such flats in Bukit Merah
item.description: A five-room HDB flat at 9A Boon Tiong Road was recently sold for $1.649 million ($1,368 psf), setting a new record high for such flats in Bukit Merah. Located on the 25th to 27th storeys, the 1,206-sq ft flat has a long remaining lease of around 89 years, which could have contributed to its eye-watering price. item.description: Eight strata retail units located on the ground floor of Plus, an office building at 20 Cecil Street, are being launched for sale via expression of interest (EOI) with CBRE appointed as its exclusive marketing agent. item.title: RealVantage enters digital infrastructure space with USD7 mil investment in US data centre
item.description: Singapore-based real estate investment firm RealVantage is investing in a US data centre, marking the firm's inaugural foray into the digital infrastructure space. item.title: Freehold food factory on Genting Road for sale at $38 mil
item.description: A newly completed food factory located at 25 Genting Road is up for sale by private treaty. The freehold four-storey building has an asking price of $38 million, according to CBRE, the property’s marketing agent. The factory occupies 10,526 sq ft of land zoned for Business 1 or light industrial use. Purpose-built for food production, it contains 13 units and has a total gross floor area (GFA) of 26,287 sq ft. item.title: Soon Hock buys industrial asset Kewalram House en bloc for $120.51 mil
item.description: The collective sale tender for Kewalram House, a private industrial asset along Jalan Kilang Timor in the Bukit Merah industrial precinct, closed on March 24. The same day, Soon Hock Enterprise Holding announced via a bourse filing that it was awarded the tender for the 99-year leasehold development at a sale price of $120.51 million. item.description: CapitaLand Ascendas Reit (CLAR) has raised $903.5 million in gross proceeds from a private placement and a preferential offering launched on March 24.
